title: Euphoria

source.dataset: psychonautwiki_db.zip (psychonautwiki.db, SQLite export provided by Hany, file dated 2026-11-25)

plain_text:
Euphoria (semantically opposite of dysphoria) is medically recognized as a mental and emotional condition in which a person experiences intense feelings of well-being, elation, happiness, excitement and joy. In the context of drug use, however, it can be split into two distinct states. These are listed below:

Physical euphoria

Cognitive euphoria

See also

*Responsible use
*Muscle relaxation
*Tactile enhancement
*Anxiety suppression

External links

*Euphoria (Wikipedia)
